findings.explanation: Toys/premium listing, gross 5114.31, contractual commission rate 17% => expected fee -869.43 (net 4222.98). Settlement row ST-0300021 charged fee -969.16 (net 4123.25), an overcharge of 99.73 not explained by any rule (no low-ticket fee applies since unit price 1704.77 >= 79).

Home/premium heavy-weight order, gross 2006.08, contractual commission rate 17% => expected fee -341.03, shipping -39.90, net 1625.15. Settlement row ST-0300006 charged fee -400.21 (net 1565.97), an overcharge of 59.18 with no matching rule (shipping correctly deducted at 39.90 for heavy).

Order gross 64.74 (electronics/premium, low-ticket fee applies) expects a single payment row net 48.13. Two identical payment rows exist (ST-0300026 and ST-0300057), each gross 64.74 / fee -16.61 / net 48.13, summing to net 96.26 - the entire order was settled twice.
Fashion/classic order, gross 42.15, delivered status, expected payment row net 30.42 (commission 13% + low-ticket fee since unit price 42.15 < 79). No settlement rows exist at all for this order.

Settlement row ST-0400068 (gross 214.15, fee -27.84, net 186.31) references order MLB-049648, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. There is no corresponding sale to justify this payout.

Order is category 'home', weight_class 'heavy', gross 3043.08 >= 79.00, so expected shipping deduction is 39.90 (heavy rate). Settlement row ST-0400057 deducted -61.80 in shipping (39.90+21.90, i.e. both heavy and standard rates combined), producing net 2463.96 instead of expected 2485.86. Commission (-517.32) matches expected exactly, isolating the entire delta to shipping.

Order is category 'books', weight_class 'standard', gross 882.88 >= 79.00, so expected shipping deduction is 21.90 (standard rate). Settlement row ST-0400067 deducted -39.90 (the heavy rate) instead, producing net 754.69 instead of expected 772.69. Commission (-88.29) matches expected exactly, isolating the entire delta to shipping.

Order refunded in full (gross 1211.46, commission 145.38, heavy shipping 39.90). Only the original payment row (net 1026.18) exists; no refund row was ever settled. Expected total net across payment+refund = -39.90 (payment 1026.18 minus refund 1066.08), but observed total is 1026.18 since the refund never posted.

Delivered order (home, premium, heavy, gross 909.36) has zero settlement rows at all. Expected payment row: gross 909.36, commission -154.59 (17%), shipping -39.90, net 714.87. Observed net is 0.00 - the payment was never settled.

Order status is cancelled (pre-payment cancellation), which per rules must have NO settlement rows. However a payment row was settled: gross 363.23, fee -54.48, shipping -21.90, net 286.85. Expected net for a cancelled order is 0.00.

Full refund of a fashion/classic order (gross 38.40, commission 11.24 including low-ticket fee). Expected refund row: gross -38.40, fee +11.24 (commission returned), net -27.16. Observed refund row: gross -38.40, fee 0.00, net -38.40 - the commission was not returned to the seller, costing an extra 11.24.

Toys/premium order, gross 434.84, contractual rate 17% => expected commission -73.92 (net 339.02). Observed settlement charged fee -82.62 (net 330.32), equivalent to a 19% rate, not matching any schedule entry - an overcharge of 8.70.

Order is 60% partially refunded (refund=1158.25 of gross=1930.41). Expected refund row per rules: gross=-1158.25, fee=+185.32 (60% of the 308.87 commission returned to seller), net=-972.93. Observed refund row shows fee=0.00, net=-1158.25. The marketplace failed to return the prorated commission, shorting the seller by 185.32.

Order MLB-060087 (status=paid, gross=236.59, fashion/premium) has zero settlement rows on the statement. Expected payment row: fee=-42.59 (18% commission), shipping=-21.90, net=172.10. Seller has not been paid at all for this order.

Order MLB-060091 (books/classic, gross=67.18, expected single payment net=47.96 incl. low-ticket fee 6.25*2) was settled twice: ST-0600112 (2026-07-31) and ST-0600145 (2026-08-01), each with identical gross=67.18, fee=-19.22, net=47.96. Total observed net=95.92 vs expected 47.96 - the seller was paid twice for one order.
Order MLB-060070 has weight_class=standard, so shipping should be 21.90, but the settlement row (ST-0600083) deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate), overcharging the seller by 18.00 on shipping.

Order MLB-060070 (electronics/classic, gross=131.36, unit_price=65.68<79 so low-ticket fee applies): expected commission = round(131.36*11%)=14.45 + low-ticket 6.25*2=12.50, total fee=-26.95. Observed fee on ST-0600083 is -29.41, an excess charge of 2.46 beyond the contracted fee.

Order MLB-060094 has weight_class=standard, so shipping should be 21.90, but settlement row ST-0600114 deducted -39.90 (heavy rate), overcharging the seller by 18.00 on shipping while the commission fee (-37.04) matches the expected 12% toys/classic rate exactly.

Order MLB-060038 (electronics/premium, gross=108.54, unit_price=36.18<79 so low-ticket fee applies): expected commission = round(108.54*16%)=17.37 + low-ticket 6.25*3=18.75, total fee=-36.12. Observed fee on ST-0600042 is -38.05, an excess of 1.93 charged against the seller.

Settlement row ST-0700194 (payment, gross 662.56, fee -86.13, net 576.43) references order MLB-079870 which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding order can justify this payout.

Order MLB-070061 (electronics, classic, gross 113.30, standard shipping) is 'delivered' and expects a payment row of gross 113.30, fee -12.46, shipping -21.90, net 78.94 per calc_expected, but zero settlement rows exist for it.

Order MLB-070067 has status 'cancelled', which per Rule 6 must carry NO settlement rows at all, yet a payment row ST-0700195 exists (gross 77.33, fee -19.40, net 57.93). The seller was paid out for an order that should never have settled.

Order MLB-070006 is partially_refunded with refund_amount 45.76 on gross 76.26 (fashion classic, 13% + low-ticket fee, commission 16.16). Expected lines: payment net 60.10 AND a refund row (gross -45.76, fee +9.70, net -36.06) totaling expected_net 24.04. Only the payment row (net 60.10) is present; the refund row was never settled, leaving the seller with 36.06 more than owed.

Order MLB-070119 is weight_class 'heavy', so shipping should be 39.90 per Rule 2, giving expected net 1523.25 (gross 1756.35, fee -193.20, ship -39.90). The settlement row instead deducted shipping of 61.80 (net 1501.35), an overcharge of 21.90 that exactly accounts for the full delta.

Order MLB-070003 is toys/premium (17% commission), gross 244.74, so expected commission is round(244.74*0.17)=41.61, giving expected net 181.23. The settlement instead charged fee -45.99 (net 176.85), an overcharge of 4.38 which fully explains the observed delta.

Order gross 2602.59 with commission 286.28 and heavy shipping 39.90 gives expected net 2276.41 (single payment). Two identical payment rows (ST-0800221 and ST-0800233) both carry the full fee and shipping, doubling net to 4552.82. This is not a legitimate split (which would carry fees only on the first row) since both rows have identical fee/shipping/gross.

Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), so per rule 6 it should carry zero settlement rows. However a payment row ST-0800232 exists with gross 431.24, fee -73.31, ship -21.90, net 336.03, giving the seller money it should never have received.

Delivered order (fashion, classic, unit 65.12<79 triggers low-ticket fee) expects one payment row: gross 130.24, commission+fixed fee -29.43, shipping -21.90, net 78.91. No settlement rows exist at all for this order.

Partially_refunded order (30% of 1149.47 = 344.84). Expected refund row: gross -344.84, marketplace_fee +41.38 (30% of the 137.94 commission returned), net -303.46. Observed refund row ST-0800023 has fee 0.00, net -344.84, i.e. the 41.38 commission refund was never credited back to the seller.

Order weight_class is 'heavy', so shipping should be a single 39.90 deduction, giving expected net 425.75. Observed payment row ST-0800078 deducts -61.80 shipping (= 21.90 standard + 39.90 heavy summed), producing net 403.85, 21.90 lower than owed.

Fashion/premium listing should carry an 18% commission: 734.75*0.18=132.26, expected net 580.59. Observed payment row ST-0800128 charges fee -146.51 (effective ~19.94%), 14.25 more than the contractual commission, giving net 566.34.

Electronics/classic order: commission should be 11% of 4219.64 = 464.16 (round_half_up), expected net 3715.58. Observed payment row ST-0800098 charges fee -464.62, 0.46 above the contractual commission, giving net 3715.12 - beyond the 0.02 rounding tolerance.

Order is fully refunded (gross 3246.00, refund 3246.00) but the settlement statement only has the original payment row (net 2686.74); no refund row (expected net -2726.64) was ever posted. Expected order net total = -39.90, observed = 2686.74.

Order gross is 521.19 (single unit, qty 1) but two payment rows were posted, EACH carrying the full gross (521.19) and the full fee/shipping (-93.81/-21.90), summing to net 810.96 instead of the expected 405.48. A legitimate split would put the fees only on the first row and the remaining gross (with no fees) on the second row; here both rows are identical full charges, i.e. the payment was booked twice.
Settlement row ST-0900298 (net 370.24) references order MLB-099824, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book, so there is no contractual basis for this payout.
Fashion/classic order, gross 1594.57, correct commission rate is 13% => expected fee -207.29, but the payment row charged -251.14, an overcharge of 43.85 (251.14-207.29).

This is a full refund; the rules require the refund row to return the commission (marketplace_fee = +207.29, based on the correct 13% rate) with net -1387.28. The observed refund row instead returned fee=0.00, net=-1594.57, i.e. the seller never got the 207.29 commission credited back.

Order MLB-090238 (status=paid, gross 229.44, home/classic, unit price 76.48<79 so low-ticket fee applies) has an expected settlement of net 161.26 (fee -46.28, shipping -21.90), but there are zero settlement rows for this order.

Home/classic order, gross 2272.51, correct commission rate is 12% => expected fee -272.70, but the payment row charged -335.42, an overcharge of 62.72 (335.42-272.70). Shipping (-39.90, heavy) matches expectation.

Home/premium order, gross 2303.40, correct commission rate is 17% => expected fee -391.58, but the payment row charged -442.95, an overcharge of 51.37 (442.95-391.58). Shipping (-39.90, heavy) matches expectation.

Fashion/premium order, weight_class standard, so the seller should be charged the standard shipping rate of -21.90. The settlement row instead deducted -39.90 (the heavy rate), overcharging shipping by 18.00. Commission of -456.16 (18% of 2534.22) is correct.

Settlement row ST-1000340 (gross 661.91, fee -86.05, net 575.86) references order MLB-109378, which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No corresponding order was ever created/recorded, so the expected net for this id is 0.00 vs observed net 575.86.
Order is 'paid' (home/classic, heavy, gross 419.68). Expected settlement: commission 12% = 50.36, shipping (heavy) 39.90, expected net 329.42. No settlement rows exist at all (observed net 0.00).

Order status is 'cancelled' (books/classic, gross 52.58). Rule 6 requires cancelled orders to have NO settlement rows, but a payment row ST-1000339 was found (gross 52.58, fee -11.51, net 41.07) giving the seller a payout of 41.07 for an order that should never have settled.

Order weight_class is 'standard' (toys/premium, gross 432.18), so correct shipping deduction is 21.90, giving expected net 336.81 (fee -73.47, ship -21.90). Observed settlement ST-1000075 deducted shipping of 39.90 (the 'heavy' rate) instead, giving net 318.81 - a 18.00 BRL over-deduction.

Order is fully refunded (books/premium, gross 74.56, low-ticket fee applies, commission 15%+6.25 = 17.43). Rule 4 requires the refund row to return the commission: expected refund row gross -74.56, fee +17.43, net -57.13. Observed refund row ST-1000066 has fee 0.00 and net -74.56, i.e. the 17.43 commission was never returned to the seller. Combined order net: expected 0.00, observed -17.43.

Order is fashion/premium, gross 406.02, correct commission rate 18% => 73.08 (round_half_up(406.02*0.18)). Expected payment row: fee -73.08, ship -21.90, net 311.04. Observed settlement ST-1000185 charged fee -84.49 (11.41 more than the contractual rate), giving net 299.63.

Order is fully refunded (fashion/premium, gross 17.83, low-ticket fee applies, commission+fee = 9.46). Expected settlement: payment row net 8.37 plus a refund row (gross -17.83, fee +9.46, net -8.37), for a total expected net of 0.00. Only the payment row (ST-1000337, net 8.37) exists; no refund row was ever settled, leaving the seller holding 8.37 that should have been clawed back with the refund.

Order is books/premium, gross 2380.47, correct commission rate 15% => round_half_up(2380.47*0.15)=357.07. Expected payment net = 2380.47-357.07-21.90=2001.50. Observed settlement ST-1000205 charged fee -357.75 (0.68 more than contractual), giving net 2000.82.

Order status is 'cancelled' (cancelled before payment), so per rule 6 it must carry NO settlement rows. However settlement row ST-1100398 shows a full payment: gross 1465.32, fee -175.84, ship -39.90, net 1249.58. Expected net is 0.00.
Order is 'paid' with gross 811.30 (toys, classic, standard). Expected settlement per calc_expected is net 692.04, but there are zero settlement rows for this order (observed net 0.00).

Order gross 272.00 (electronics, classic) generates one legitimate payment of net 220.18 (fee -29.92, ship -21.90). Instead two identical payment rows exist (ST-1100368 and ST-1100397), each carrying the full fee and shipping (not a fee-only-on-first-row split), doubling gross to 544.00 and net to 440.36. This is a duplicate, not a legitimate split, since both rows carry full fees/shipping instead of the second row being fee-free.

Order is 'partially_refunded' with refund_amount 240.13 on gross 1200.66 (home, premium, heavy, 17% commission). calc_expected requires a refund row: gross -240.13, fee +40.82, net -199.31, giving expected total net 757.34. Only the payment row (net 956.65) appears on the statement; the refund row is entirely missing, leaving observed net at 956.65.

Order gross 1581.29 (electronics, premium => 16% commission). Expected commission = round(1581.29*0.16) = 253.01, expected net 1288.38. Observed settlement row ST-1100185 charged fee -295.70 (net 1245.69), a commission overcharge of 42.69 with shipping matching the expected -39.90 (heavy).
Order gross 203.35 (toys, premium => 17% commission). Expected commission = round(203.35*0.17) = 34.57. Observed fee on ST-1100167 is -37.99, an overcharge of 3.42.
Order weight_class is 'standard', so expected shipping deduction is 21.90. Observed settlement row ST-1100167 deducted -39.90 (the 'heavy' rate), an overcharge of 18.00.

Order weight_class is 'standard' (fashion, premium, gross 1925.44), so expected shipping is 21.90 and expected net 1556.96 (fee -346.58 matches observed exactly). Observed row ST-1100296 deducted -39.90 (heavy rate) instead, producing net 1538.96, an 18.00 shipping overcharge with fee otherwise correct.

Order is 'partially_refunded' (50% of gross 203.09 = refund_amount 101.55, books/premium => 15% commission). Payment row matches expectation exactly (net 150.73). Per rules, the refund row should return commission pro-rata: fee +round(30.46*0.5)=+15.23, giving refund net -86.32. Observed refund row ST-1100109 shows fee 0.00 and net -101.55 (commission not returned), a shortfall of 15.23 versus expected.
Order is 'paid' with expected net 1264.67 (per calc_expected) but has zero settlement rows on the statement. The entire settlement for this order is missing.
Settlement row ST-1200461 (gross 454.05, fee -59.03, net 395.02) references order MLB-129910 which does not exist anywhere in the seller's order book. No order justifies this payout.

Order partially refunded 1233.56 of gross 6167.82 (13% fashion/classic commission = 801.82). Expected refund row: gross -1233.56, fee +160.36 (13% of 1233.56 returned), net -1073.20. Observed refund row ST-1200062 has fee 0.00, net -1233.56 - the proportional commission was never returned to the seller.
Order status is 'cancelled', which per rules must carry NO settlement rows. However settlement row ST-1200462 exists with gross 217.59, fee -42.68, ship -21.90, net 153.01.

Order status is 'refunded' (full refund of 151.73). Expected settlement: payment row net 114.66 plus a refund row net -136.56, for an expected total net of -21.90. Only the payment row (net 114.66) is present; the refund row was never settled, leaving the seller with net 114.66 instead of the contractual -21.90.

Order gross 78.41 (electronics, premium, low-ticket fee applies) should settle once with net 59.61 (fee -18.80). It was settled twice: ST-1200056 and ST-1200460, both identical (gross 78.41, fee -18.80, net 59.61), summing to net 119.22 - double the expected 59.61.

Order weight_class is 'standard', so shipping deduction should be 21.90 (expected net 321.10, fee -42.39, ship -21.90). Observed settlement ST-1200136 deducted the 'heavy' rate of 39.90 instead, giving net 303.10 - an 18.00 excess deduction.

Order weight_class is 'standard', so shipping deduction should be 21.90 (expected net 492.43, fee -76.85, ship -21.90). Observed settlement ST-1200219 deducted 39.90 (heavy rate) instead, giving net 474.43 - an 18.00 excess deduction.

Order is electronics/classic, gross 106.40, expected commission 11% = 11.70 (expected payment net 72.80). Observed payment row ST-1200146 charged fee -13.49, net 71.01 - a 1.79 overcharge on commission.

Full refund expected to return the 11.70 commission (expected refund net -94.70: gross -106.40 + fee +11.70). Observed refund row ST-1200147 has fee 0.00, net -106.40 - commission was not returned at all, an additional 11.70 shortfall to the seller.
Order is toys/classic, gross 630.17, expected commission 12% = 75.62 (expected net 532.65). Observed settlement ST-1200308 charged fee -85.20, net 523.07 - a 9.58 commission overcharge.
Order is books/classic, gross 343.59, expected commission 10% = 34.36 (expected net 287.33). Observed settlement ST-1200277 charged fee -41.64, net 280.05 - a 7.28 commission overcharge.

Order is toys/classic, gross 2031.52, expected commission 12% = 243.78 (expected net 1765.84). Observed settlement ST-1200022 charged fee -244.15, net 1765.47 - a 0.37 commission overcharge, above the 0.02 rounding tolerance.
